mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND created_at >= #{from}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE created_at >= #{from}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE created_at >= #{from}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT target_type, target_id FROM reports WHERE status = 'pending') t
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM notification_devices
SELECT s.provider, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM user_social_accounts s JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY s.provider
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_id) FROM user_social_accounts s JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND password_hash = 'SOCIAL_ONLY'

SELECT 'google' AS provider, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM user_google_calendar c JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'naver', COUNT(*) FROM user_naver_calendar c JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'kakao', COUNT(*) FROM user_kakao_calendar c JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT x.user_id) FROM ( SELECT user_id FROM user_google_calendar UNION SELECT user_id FROM user_naver_calendar UNION SELECT user_id FROM user_kakao_calendar ) x JOIN users u ON u.user_id = x.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0
mapper.sql: u.user_id AS userId, u.name, u.login_id AS loginId, u.member_type AS memberType, u.admin_level AS adminLevel, u.created_at AS joinedAt, COALESCE(la.last_access, u.last_login_at) AS lastAccessAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification_devices d WHERE d.user_id = u.user_id) AS deviceCount
LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, MAX(access_hour) AS last_access FROM stats_access_hourly GROUP BY user_id) la ON la.user_id = u.user_id
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM users u
WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(la.last_access, u.last_login_at, u.created_at) < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY COALESCE(la.last_access, u.last_login_at, u.created_at) ASC, u.user_id ASC

SELECT FROM users u
WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notification_devices d WHERE d.user_id = u.user_id) ORDER BY COALESCE(la.last_access, u.last_login_at, u.created_at) DESC, u.user_id ASC

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.name, u.login_id AS loginId, u.member_type AS memberType, u.admin_level AS adminLevel, u.created_at AS joinedAt, COALESCE(la.last_access, u.last_login_at) AS lastAccessAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p WHERE p.user_id = u.user_id AND p.created_at >= #{from}) AS postCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.user_id = u.user_id AND c.created_at >= #{from}) AS commentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification_devices d WHERE d.user_id = u.user_id) AS deviceCount FROM users u
WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 HAVING postCount + commentCount > 0 ORDER BY postCount + commentCount DESC, postCount DESC, u.user_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT b.board_id AS boardId, b.name AS boardName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p WHERE p.board_id = b.board_id AND p.created_at >= #{from}) AS postCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c JOIN posts p ON p.post_id = c.post_id WHERE p.board_id = b.board_id AND c.created_at >= #{from}) AS commentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_likes l JOIN posts p ON p.post_id = l.post_id WHERE p.board_id = b.board_id AND l.created_at >= #{from}) AS likeCount FROM boards b WHERE b.state = 'normal' ORDER BY b.display_order ASC, b.board_id ASC
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS count FROM posts WHERE created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY statDate
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS count FROM comments WHERE created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY statDate
mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stats_access_hourly a WHERE a.user_id = u.user_id AND a.access_hour >= DATE(u.created_at) + INTERVAL ${n} * 7 DAY AND a.access_hour < DATE(u.created_at) + INTERVAL ${n} * 7 + 7 DAY)
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(u.created_at) - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(u.created_at) DAY AS weekStart, COUNT(*) AS signups, SUM(DATE(u.created_at) + INTERVAL 14 DAY <= CURDATE()) AS w1Eligible, SUM(DATE(u.created_at) + INTERVAL 14 DAY <= CURDATE() AND ) AS w1Retained, SUM(DATE(u.created_at) + INTERVAL 21 DAY <= CURDATE()) AS w2Eligible, SUM(DATE(u.created_at) + INTERVAL 21 DAY <= CURDATE() AND ) AS w2Retained, SUM(DATE(u.created_at) + INTERVAL 35 DAY <= CURDATE()) AS w4Eligible, SUM(DATE(u.created_at) + INTERVAL 35 DAY <= CURDATE() AND ) AS w4Retained FROM users u WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY weekStart ORDER BY weekStart DESC

SELECT b.board_id AS boardId, b.name AS boardName, COUNT(p.post_id) AS postCount, COALESCE(SUM(c.cnt), 0) AS commentCount, COALESCE(SUM(l.cnt), 0) AS likeCount, COALESCE(SUM(p.post_id IS NOT NULL AND c.cnt IS NULL), 0) AS zeroCommentPosts FROM boards b LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.board_id = b.board_id AND p.state = 'normal' AND p.created_at >= #{from} LEFT JOIN (SELECT cm.post_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM comments cm JOIN posts pp ON pp.post_id = cm.post_id AND pp.created_at >= #{from} WHERE cm.state = 'normal' AND cm.is_private = 0 GROUP BY cm.post_id) c ON c.post_id = p.post_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT pl.post_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM post_likes pl JOIN posts pp ON pp.post_id = pl.post_id AND pp.created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY pl.post_id) l ON l.post_id = p.post_id WHERE b.state = 'normal' GROUP BY b.board_id, b.name, b.display_order ORDER BY b.display_order ASC, b.board_id ASC

SELECT p.board_id AS boardId, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, p.created_at, MIN(c.created_at)) AS minutes FROM posts p JOIN comments c ON c.post_id = p.post_id AND c.state = 'normal' AND c.is_private = 0 AND c.user_id <> p.user_id WHERE p.state = 'normal' AND p.created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY p.post_id, p.board_id, p.created_at

SELECT x.provider, 'FAILED' AS issue, u.user_id AS userId, u.name, u.login_id AS loginId, u.member_type AS memberType, x.failedCount, x.exhaustedCount, x.lastError, x.lastReflectedAt FROM ( SELECT 'google' AS provider, e.user_id, COUNT(*) AS failedCount, SUM(e.retry_count >= #{maxRetry}) AS exhaustedCount, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(e.last_error ORDER BY e.updated_at DESC SEPARATOR '
'), '
', 1) AS lastError, (SELECT COALESCE(g.last_synced_at, g.linked_at) FROM user_google_calendar g WHERE g.user_id = e.user_id) AS lastReflectedAt FROM user_calendar_events e WHERE e.sync_status = 'FAILED' GROUP BY e.user_id UNION ALL SELECT 'kakao', e.user_id, COUNT(*), SUM(e.retry_count >= #{maxRetry}), SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(e.last_error ORDER BY e.updated_at DESC SEPARATOR '
'), '
', 1), (SELECT COALESCE(k.last_synced_at, k.linked_at) FROM user_kakao_calendar k WHERE k.user_id = e.user_id) FROM user_kakao_calendar_events e WHERE e.sync_status = 'FAILED' GROUP BY e.user_id ) x JOIN users u ON u.user_id = x.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY x.provider, x.failedCount DESC, u.user_id

SELECT 'naver' AS provider, 'TOKEN' AS issue, u.user_id AS userId, u.name, u.login_id AS loginId, u.member_type AS memberType, COALESCE(n.last_sent_at, n.linked_at) AS lastReflectedAt FROM user_naver_calendar n JOIN users u ON u.user_id = n.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE n.access_expires_at < NOW() AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events ev WHERE ev.created_at > n.access_expires_at + INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND ev.created_at > n.linked_at) ORDER BY n.access_expires_at ASC, u.user_id

SELECT x.provider, 'STALE' AS issue, u.user_id AS userId, u.name, u.login_id AS loginId, u.member_type AS memberType, x.lastReflectedAt FROM ( SELECT 'google' AS provider, user_id, COALESCE(last_synced_at, linked_at) AS lastReflectedAt FROM user_google_calendar UNION ALL SELECT 'kakao', user_id, COALESCE(last_synced_at, linked_at) FROM user_kakao_calendar UNION ALL SELECT 'naver', user_id, COALESCE(last_sent_at, linked_at) FROM user_naver_calendar ) x JOIN users u ON u.user_id = x.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE x.lastReflectedAt < NOW() - INTERVAL #{days} DAY ORDER BY x.lastReflectedAt ASC, u.user_id
